name: Google Sheets (read-only, service account)
description: Google Sheets, read-only (scope spreadsheets.readonly): spreadsheets.get and values.get / values:batchGet by spreadsheet ID. Cannot edit. Auth: drawlatch signs a JWT with GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY (base64 of the service-account JSON key file) and mints short-lived access tokens for exactly this scope; the agent never sees the key. Without a subject it reads spreadsheets shared with the service account; with one (domain-wide delegation) that user's. See CONNECTIONS.md "Google (scoped)".

testConnection.description: Reads the ID of Google's public sample spreadsheet (needs the Sheets API enabled)
